title: abm-io: checkpoints, agent exchange and visualization files for agent-based simulators
description: A simulator-independent library for the files and messages an agent-based simulation needs: checkpoints that restore a run exactly, exchange of agents between processes, and visualization output. Types are described once, in a schema with roles and units, and that description drives reading, writing, exchange and the checks on a restart. See the release notes for what this version delivers, the decisions it rests on, and the measurements behind them.
